$description: Statement-picker permutation coverage for workspace 55390: one delivered
service row per (board, participant, year 2022-2026, month 1-12), so every
Monthly Statement Generator combination loads a non-empty statement.
Amounts vary deterministically per permutation (90/10 subsidy split).
Composable: load on top of care-management-automation.json or
care-management-55390-full.json — ids are disjoint (55390e00- prefix) and
profiles/plans/funding sources are self-contained. No Timesheet Approval
anywhere, so no invoice path can ever bill these rows. Note they DO appear
in the offline invoice-generator lists (no ISO+ folder filter offline).
Years mirror the 2026 picker (currentYear-4 .. currentYear); regenerate

capturedFrom.via: synthesized from the monthly-statement picker matrix (5 years x 12 months x board participants)
